tools.name: synchroteam_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers (name wildcard, e-mail, active flag, change time). Returns name, address, contact, custom fields, tags. GET /customer/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id, myId, exact name or e-mail, with address, contact, custom fields and tags. GET /customer/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_sites
tools.description: List or search sites (a customer's locations): by name, customer, active flag, change time. GET /site/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_site
tools.description: One site by id, myId or exact name: address, contact, customer, custom fields, tags. GET /site/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_equipment
tools.description: List or search pieces of equipment (assets) by name, customer, site, active flag, change time. GET /equipment/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_equipment
tools.description: One piece of equipment by id, myId or exact name, with its customer and site. GET /equipment/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (simplified: no report, parts or time entries) filtered by status, schedule window, technician, team, customer, site, equipment, job type or project. Use synchroteam_get_job for the full record. GET /job/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_job
tools.description: One job by num (the job number shown in the app), id or myId: status, customer/site/equipment, technician(s), schedule, actual times, time entries, parts used, report and custom fields. GET /job/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_job_photos
tools.description: Photo links of a job (url, file name, comment, report iteration). Image bytes are never returned. GET /job/photos.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_job_types
tools.description: List job types (name, default duration, priority, skills, default report). Use their id or name when creating a job. GET /jobtype/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_users
tools.description: List users: login, name, profile (technician, manager, administrator), teams, skills, last known location. Passwords are never returned. GET /user/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_user
tools.description: One user by login or id. GET /user/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_teams
tools.description: List teams with member counts and tags. GET /team/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_parts
tools.description: List the parts and services catalog (reference, name, price, category, tax, tracked/serialized flags, type). GET /part/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_part
tools.description: One part or service by id or reference. GET /part/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_depots
tools.description: List stock depots (warehouses and technician vans). The part quantities of one depot come from synchroteam_get_depot. GET /depot/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_depot
tools.description: One stock depot by id, with the quantity of each part it holds. GET /depot/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_part_requests
tools.description: List technicians' part requests (urgent, sent, completed, deleted flags). GET /partrequest/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices (read only): number, status, customer, job, lines, totals. Filter by status, customer, site, job or time. GET /invoice/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id, reference or number, with its lines. GET /invoice/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_quotations
tools.description: List quotations (read only): number, status, customer, job, lines, totals. GET /quotation/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_quotation
tools.description: One quotation by id, reference or number, with its lines. GET /quotation/details.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_contracts
tools.description: List service contracts by name, customer, site, period or active flag. GET /contract/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (groups of jobs) by customer, site, equipment or project type. GET /project/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_activities
tools.description: List time entries and unavailabilities (travel, at work, clock, unavailable) of technicians. start_date and end_date go together and return anything overlapping that range. GET /activity/list.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (name and an address are required). If you pass myId and a customer with that myId already exists, nothing is created and an error is returned (use synchroteam_update_customer). POST /customer/send.

tools.name: synchroteam_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer by its numeric id. Only the fields you pass are changed; nothing is cleared. The customer id must exist (an unknown id fails). POST /customer/send.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_site
tools.description: WRITE: create a new site (a location of a customer). Needs a name, an address and the customer (id or myId). If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned. POST /site/send.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_equipment
tools.description: WRITE: create a new piece of equipment under a site or a customer (give exactly one of site or customer; both is refused). If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned. POST /equipment/send.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job for a customer (status created, not yet scheduled; use synchroteam_schedule_job to assign a technician and time). The customer is required (id, myId or exact name); site, equipment and job type are optional. If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned.

tools.name: synchroteam_schedule_job
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a job for a technician between two times (also re-schedules a scheduled or paused job). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "synchroteam_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List users: login, name, profile (technician, manager, administrator), teams, skills, last known location. Passwords are never returned. GET /user/list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: synchroteam_get_job_photos · Private data: synchroteam_list_customers, synchroteam_get_customer, synchroteam_get_site, synchroteam_list_jobs, synchroteam_get_job_photos, synchroteam_list_users · Public sink: synchroteam_create_customer, synchroteam_update_customer, synchroteam_create_site, synchroteam_create_equipment, synchroteam_create_job, synchroteam_schedule_job, synchroteam_start_job, synchroteam_complete_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: synchroteam_get_job_photos · Private data: synchroteam_list_customers, synchroteam_get_customer, synchroteam_get_site, synchroteam_list_jobs, synchroteam_get_job_photos, synchroteam_list_users · Public sink: synchroteam_create_customer, synchroteam_update_customer, synchroteam_create_site, synchroteam_create_equipment, synchroteam_create_job, synchroteam_schedule_job, synchroteam_start_job, synchroteam_complete_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
